RC-DEPENDENCY-001.description: Committed dependency graph cannot be installed or resolved.

RC-TYPE-001.description: Canonical type graph and its consumers are inconsistent.

RC-ROUTER-001.description: Public route or canonical route resolution is inconsistent.

RC-I18N-001.description: Locale, translation, or localized UI contract is inconsistent.

RC-I18N-SOT-001.description: Canonical locale configuration, loader and dictionaries are inconsistent.

RC-SEO-001.description: Canonical, hreflang, robots, sitemap, or SEO metadata contract is inconsistent.

RC-A11Y-001.description: Accessibility contract is violated in rendered browser output.

RC-RUNTIME-001.description: Browser runtime or console execution contract failed.

RC-NETWORK-001.description: Browser request or network contract failed.

RC-BUILD-001.description: Production build or generated artifact contract failed.

RC-BROWSER-001.description: Browser gate failed without a more specific classified root cause.

RC-UNKNOWN-001.description: Failure could not be assigned to a known root cause.

RC-DIAGNOSTIC-001.description: No gate report was produced; diagnostic evidence is incomplete.

RC-DIAGNOSTIC-002.description: A gate report exists but cannot be parsed as valid JSON.

RC-CI-CONTRACT-001.description: CI workflow and executable certification contract have drifted.

RC-CI-TECHNICAL-DEBT-001.description: Blocking technical debt remains in the active CI execution graph.

RC-CI-CONTEXT-001.description: Execution context does not describe the installed dependency environment actually tested.

RC-CI-EVIDENCE-001.description: Evidence bundle is stale, incomplete, or not authoritative for the executed gates.

RC-CI-FINGERPRINT-001.description: Failure fingerprints are unstable because volatile dependency context participates in identity.

RC-CI-COVERAGE-SOT-001.description: Expected gate/check counts are duplicated across runner and evidence collectors.

RC-TEST-SURFACE-FRAGMENTATION-001.description: Multiple package scripts define overlapping independent verification lifecycles.

RC-BROWSER-STANDALONE-001.description: Standalone browser certification is blocked because browser execution assumes an in-process BUILD report.

RC-RELEASE-JOB-CONTEXT-001.description: Release engineering gate lacked an independent repository checkout and Node dependency bootstrap.
